prompt: Create an original 60 second acoustic minimalism instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: marimba, piano, muted strings. Style: phase-shifted repeating figures with small harmonic changes. Tempo approximately 120 BPM; C major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A whimsical and slightly melancholic orchestral piece with a waltz-like rhythm, featuring piano, strings, and woodwinds. It evokes a sense of playful elegance and reflection.
description.zh: 一首异想天开又略带忧郁的管弦乐曲，带有华尔兹般的节奏，以钢琴、弦乐和木管乐器为主。它唤起了一种俏皮的优雅和沉思感。
